name: siid-compression
description: Provider-agnostic context-compression layer that all SIID AI conversations flow through. Ships our own Node.js OpenRouter proxy + compression strategy; falls back to passthrough when the proxy is unavailable.

siidCompression.enabled.description: Master switch. When off, every consumer transparently gets passthrough (messages unchanged).

siidCompression.backend.description: Which inline (diagnostics/simulate) backend to use. 'auto' picks the best healthy backend and falls back to passthrough. The primary traffic path is always the proxy.

siidCompression.healthCheckTtlMs.description: How long a backend health check is cached before it is re-checked.

siidCompression.proxy.serverPath.description: Absolute path to the proxy server script. Leave empty to use the bundled out/proxy/server.js.

siidCompression.proxy.nodePath.description: Node executable used to run the proxy. Leave empty to use the SIID/VS Code process's own Node runtime.

siidCompression.proxy.port.description: Preferred port for the managed proxy. 0 = pick a free port automatically.

siidCompression.proxy.host.description: Host the managed proxy binds to. Use 127.0.0.1, not localhost.

siidCompression.proxy.upstreamUrl.description: OpenRouter-compatible upstream base URL. Empty = OpenRouter default (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1).

siidCompression.proxy.openrouterApiKey.description: OpenRouter API key injected into the proxy's environment (OPENROUTER_API_KEY). Leave empty to use the ambient OPENROUTER_API_KEY env var, or to let the consumer's own Authorization header be forwarded.

siidCompression.proxy.extraArgs.description: Extra CLI args passed to the proxy server.

siidCompression.proxy.maxRestarts.description: Max automatic proxy restarts on unexpected exit before giving up.

siidCompression.proxy.healthTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the proxy to become healthy after spawn.

siidCompression.testConsumer.model.description: Model id the 'Run Test Consumer' command sends through the proxy to OpenRouter. Defaults to a free instruction model; free models are rate-limited.
